correctness.rationale: Definitions and quantifiers are exact: noncollinear triples in seven nonzero F2^3 points, adjacency by disjointness, G all 336 automorphisms, H6 over Q. A complete 196009-face enumeration, 98000-pair matching and 1319724-incidence DAG topological sort verify a Morse CW model with one 0-cell and seven 6-cells, proving the integral wedge. Full 336-element graph-group closure and 168 collineations checked, with literature confirming full graph-automorphism order. Lefschetz trace is computed from vertex-cycle unions and independently from explicitly signed fixed faces for all nine conjugacy classes. Eight distinct Sylow-seven subgroups and 336 exact epsilon*(f-1) identities are verified. Character equality over Q gives the module via semisimplicity; exact inner product one proves absolute irreducibility. The original result stops at this finite graph; no truncation or unverifiable infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural group-action invariant of the canonical Coxeter distance-regular cubic graph and its Fano-plane-related independence complex. The new sign twist of the rank-one Steinberg representation is not encoded by the previously known seven-sphere homotopy type or seven-dimensional homology rank. It has a concrete structural consequence (zero globally invariant sixth homology), distinguishes two rational seven-dimensional modules with the same restriction to the Fano collineation subgroup, and connects the graph-topology calculation with the canonical Sylow-seven action of PGL2(7). This is a natural complete classification for one classical object, not an arbitrary parameter increment or invented downstream application.
